description: KineGate binds a tokenized-equity trade intention to exact issuer identity, amount, permission, market/quote clocks, costs and effect evidence. Its no-wallet fixture workspace runs thirteen deterministic checks, exports an expiring SHA-256-bound local receipt and invalidates it when reviewed fields change. Authenticated Binance RWA discovery, price, issuer profile and underlying-market calls succeeded; the current AAPLon contract was separately checked on BSC at a fixed block. Judges can inspect the captured API observations as REPLAY, with missing quote, reference timestamps and execution evidence kept visible. The original client has bounded failures and explicit RFQ/EVM distinctions. No funded mainnet trade has occurred; fixture simulation and real read-only acquisition remain separate. A read-only6USDT quote succeeded with LiquidMesh and actual SWAP mode; quote replay preserves missing expiry/minimum-output fields and no funded execution is claimed. A fresh unsigned SWAP payload was built with0.5%slippage and automatic approval disabled; the official off-chain simulation predicted failure from insufficient token balance. No approval, wallet signature or broadcast occurred.
